nodes.description: Public address state variable holding the privileged administrator, set to the deployer.
Internal uint tracking the total token supply of the ERC20.
Internal mapping(address => uint) of token balances.
Internal nested mapping of owner to spender allowances.
msg.sender, the externally controlled caller identity used for authorization and transfers.
Context._msgSender() internal view returning msg.sender.
HSO constructor that sets admin, mints the total supply and credits the deployer balance.
Public transfer(address recipient, uint amount) that moves tokens from _msgSender().
Public transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint amount) that transfers and decrements allowance.
Public approve(address spender, uint amount) setting allowance from _msgSender().
Public increaseAllowance(address spender, uint addedValue) adding to the caller allowance.
Public decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint subtractedValue) subtracting from the caller allowance.
Public view balanceOf(address account) reading _balances.
Public view totalSupply() returning _totalSupply.
Public view allowance(address owner, address spender) reading _allowances.
Internal _transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint amount) mutating _balances.
Internal _approve(address owner, address spender, uint amount) mutating _allowances.
SafeERC20.safeTransfer wrapper that encodes a transfer selector and calls callOptionalReturn.
SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom wrapper delegating to callOptionalReturn.
SafeERC20.safeApprove wrapper that checks existing allowance then delegates to callOptionalReturn.
Private callOptionalReturn(IERC20 token, bytes data) performing the low-level external call and decoding the result.
Low-level address(token).call(data) external invocation of an arbitrary token with user-controlled calldata.
Address.isContract(address account) checking extcodehash via inline assembly.
Inline assembly block using extcodehash to detect contract code.
sender parameter of the internal _transfer function.
recipient parameter of the internal _transfer function.
amount parameter of the internal _transfer function.
owner parameter of the internal _approve function.
spender parameter of the internal _approve function.
addedValue parameter of increaseAllowance.
subtractedValue parameter of decreaseAllowance.
token parameter (arbitrary IERC20 target) of callOptionalReturn.
data parameter holding ABI-encoded calldata for the low-level call.
account parameter of Address.isContract.
returndata bytes local holding the optional return data of the low-level call.
success bool local capturing the result of the low-level call.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the admin state variable, giving the deployer/caller full privileged control.
The HSO constructor sets admin = msg.sender during deployment.
The constructor assigns the fixed total supply to _totalSupply.
The constructor credits _balances[admin] with the whole supply.
admin is used as the mapping key when minting balances.
_msgSender forwards the untrusted msg.sender into the ERC20 authorization flow.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the debited sender address.
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
transfer delegates the balance mutation to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates the balance mutation to _transfer.
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the spender allowance.
approve delegates to _approve.
increaseAllowance delegates to _approve.
decreaseAllowance delegates to _approve.
_transfer writes the sender and recipient entries of _balances.
_approve writes the owner/spender entry of _allowances.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
balanceOf reads the _balances mapping.
allowance reads the _allowances mapping.
sender argument flows into the internal _transfer logic.
recipient argument flows into the internal _transfer logic.
amount argument flows into the internal _transfer logic.
owner argument flows into the internal _approve logic.
spender argument flows into the internal _approve logic.
addedValue flows into the allowance incrementation arithmetic.
subtractedValue flows into the allowance decrementation arithmetic.
The arbitrary token address is supplied to callOptionalReturn for the external call.
The ABI-encoded data payload is supplied to callOptionalReturn.
account argument is checked by isContract before the external call.
callOptionalReturn executes the low-level external call to the token contract.
The encoded calldata is forwarded verbatim into address(token).call(data).
The token address becomes the target of the unchecked external invocation.
The external low-level call can re-enter the contract/library callback before success and returndata are validated.
safeTransfer forwards an encoded transfer call to callOptionalReturn.
safeTransferFrom forwards an encoded transferFrom call to callOptionalReturn.
safeApprove forwards an encoded approve call to callOptionalReturn.
isContract reads codehash through the inline assembly extcodehash operation.
The account argument is passed into the assembly extcodehash instruction.
The success local variable captures the boolean result of the low-level call.
The returndata local variable holds the optional bytes returned by the call and is ABI-decoded.
